title: Adverbial clauses of time (1)
summary: Придаточные времени: **when, while, as, before, after, until, since, once, as soon as, by the time, whenever, every time**; выбор времён (настоящее вместо будущего, perfect), различие **when / while / as** и сокращённые формы с **-ing**.
ru:
## Времена в придаточных времени
Главное правило: **после союзов времени будущее не употребляется** — вместо него настоящее время. Если действие придаточного закончится до действия главного, используется **present perfect** (или present simple, если порядок ясен без perfect).
> I'll call you **as soon as I get** home. — Позвоню, как только приду домой.
> We can't start **until everyone has arrived**. — Мы не можем начать, пока все не придут.
> **Once the contract is signed**, we'll announce the merger. — Как только договор будет подписан, объявим о слиянии.
- ~~when I will arrive~~ → **when I arrive**
- ~~After he will finish...~~ → **After he finishes / has finished...**
О прошлом всё как обычно: *When she arrived, the meeting had already started.* — Когда она пришла, совещание уже началось.

## when, while, as: нюансы
- **when** — момент, событие или отрезок: *When I was young, I lived in Riga.* / *She was walking home when it started to rain.* (короткое событие на фоне длинного)
- **while** — длительные параллельные действия: *While I was cooking, she was reading.* — Пока я готовил, она читала.
- **as** — одновременность или нарастающее изменение: *As the economy recovered, unemployment fell steadily.* — По мере восстановления экономики безработица снижалась. / *As I was leaving, the phone rang.*
- ~~While she arrived, he left.~~ → **As / When** she arrived, he left. (while не сочетается с мгновенным действием)

## before, after, until, since, by the time
- **before / after** + -ing возможны при общем подлежащем: *After leaving university, she moved to Oslo.* *Before signing, read the terms.* — Формально: **After having read...**
- **until / till** — «до тех пор, пока не» (действие длится до момента): *Wait until I call.* В отрицании: *I didn't realise until I looked again.* — Я не понял, пока не посмотрел снова.
- **by the time** — «к тому моменту, как» (завершение до): *By the time we arrived, the film had started.* / *By the time you read this, I'll have left.*
- **since** — точка отсчёта: *I've known her since we were students.* Времена: главное — perfect, придаточное — past simple.

## Мгновенно и многократно
- **as soon as, the moment (that), the minute, immediately, directly** (BrE) — сразу после: *She phoned me the moment she heard.*
- **once** — после завершения: *Once you understand the rule, the exercises are easy.*
- **whenever, every time, each time** — повторяемость: *Every time it rains, the road floods.* *Whenever she feels stressed, she goes jogging.*
- **the first / last / next time** + клауза: *The next time you visit, bring photos.* — В следующий раз привезите фото.

## Сокращённые придаточные
Если подлежащее то же, придаточное сокращают: *While waiting for the train, I read the paper.* — Пока ждал поезд... *Having finished the report, she left.* — Закончив отчёт, она ушла. *Once signed, the contract can't be changed.*

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I'll tell her when I will see her.~~ → I'll tell her when I **see** her.
- ~~I didn't know until he will tell me.~~ → I didn't know until he **told** me.
- ~~Since I live here, I have changed jobs twice.~~ → **Since I moved here**, I have changed jobs twice.
- ~~After to finish...~~ → After **finishing** / After I **finish**...
en:
## Tenses in time clauses
The key rule: **we do not use the future after time conjunctions**; we use a present tense instead. If the action of the time clause will be finished before the main action, we use **present perfect** (or present simple when the order is clear anyway).
> I'll call you **as soon as I get** home.
> We can't start **until everyone has arrived**.
> **Once the contract is signed**, we'll announce the merger.
- ~~when I will arrive~~ → **when I arrive**
- ~~After he will finish...~~ → **After he finishes / has finished...**
For the past everything is as usual: *When she arrived, the meeting had already started.*

## when, while, as: differences
- **when** — a moment, event or period: *When I was young, I lived in Riga.* / *She was walking home when it started to rain.* (a short event inside a longer one)
- **while** — long parallel actions: *While I was cooking, she was reading.*
- **as** — simultaneous actions or gradual change: *As the economy recovered, unemployment fell steadily.* / *As I was leaving, the phone rang.*
- ~~While she arrived, he left.~~ → **As / When** she arrived, he left. (while does not go with an instant action)

## before, after, until, since, by the time
- **before / after** + -ing is possible with the same subject: *After leaving university, she moved to Oslo.* *Before signing, read the terms.* Formal: **After having read...**
- **until / till** — 'up to the time when' (an action lasting up to a point): *Wait until I call.* In a negative: *I didn't realise until I looked again.*
- **by the time** — 'at or before that point': *By the time we arrived, the film had started.* / *By the time you read this, I'll have left.*
- **since** — starting point: *I've known her since we were students.* Tenses: perfect in the main clause, past simple in the clause with since.

## Immediate and repeated
- **as soon as, the moment (that), the minute, immediately, directly** (BrE) — right after: *She phoned me the moment she heard.*
- **once** — after completion: *Once you understand the rule, the exercises are easy.*
- **whenever, every time, each time** — repetition: *Every time it rains, the road floods.* *Whenever she feels stressed, she goes jogging.*
- **the first / last / next time** + clause: *The next time you visit, bring photos.*

## Reduced clauses
If the subject is the same, the clause can be shortened: *While waiting for the train, I read the paper.* *Having finished the report, she left.* *Once signed, the contract can't be changed.*

## Common mistakes
- ~~I'll tell her when I will see her.~~ → I'll tell her when I **see** her.
- ~~I didn't know until he will tell me.~~ → I didn't know until he **told** me.
- ~~Since I live here, I have changed jobs twice.~~ → **Since I moved here**, I have changed jobs twice.
- ~~After to finish...~~ → After **finishing** / After I **finish**...
structure:
## Формулы
> **время-союз** + **present simple / present perfect** (о будущем), главное: **will + глагол**
> **when / as soon as / once / until / before / after** + present, **will** + глагол
> **by the time** + present, **will have** + причастие II
> **since** + past simple, **present perfect** (главное)
> **while / as** + past continuous, past simple / continuous
> **after / before** + **-ing** (то же подлежащее); **after having** + причастие II

## Таблица союзов
| Союз | Значение | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| **when** | когда (момент) | **When** it rains, I stay in. |
| **while** | пока (длительность) | **While** I was reading, he slept. |
| **as** | по мере того как / в то время как | **As** the evening went on... |
| **until** | до тех пор, пока не | Wait **until** I call. |
| **by the time** | к тому времени как | **By the time** you come, I'll have left. |
| **since** | с тех пор как | I've worked here **since** I graduated. |
| **once** | как только / после того как | **Once** it's done, call me. |
| **as soon as / the moment** | сразу, как только | **As soon as** I know, I'll tell you. |
| **whenever / every time** | всякий раз, когда | **Whenever** she's late, he waits. |

exercises.title: Какое время?
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол из скобок в правильную форму. Если возможны два варианта — оба учтены.
exercises.example: I'll call you as soon as I (get) home. → **get**

items.text: I'll call you as soon as I {{get|have got}} home.
We can't start until everyone {{has arrived|arrives}}.
By the time you read this, I {{will have left|'ll have left}} the country.
Once the contract {{is signed|has been signed}}, we'll announce the merger.
She has worked here since she {{graduated}}.
While he {{was cooking}}, the phone rang twice.
Whenever she {{feels}} stressed, she goes jogging.
He stopped talking the moment she {{walked}} into the room.

exercises.title: Подберите союз
exercises.instruction: Вставьте один союз времени. Если возможны синонимы — они учтены.

items.text: I've known her {{since}} we were students.
Don't sign anything {{until|till|before}} you've read the small print.
{{By}} the time we arrived, the film had started.
{{Once|When|After}} you understand the rule, the exercises are easy.
She was walking home {{when|as}} it started to rain.
{{As}} the economy recovered, unemployment fell steadily.
She phoned me {{the moment|the minute|as soon as|immediately}} she heard the news.
We didn't realise the problem {{until|till}} we checked the data again.

items.q: I'll text you when I ___ at the station.
She was talking on the phone ___ the doorbell rang.
___ I was cleaning, I found my old diary.
Please wait here ___ the doctor is ready.
They had already left ___ we got there.
I've felt much better ___ I started exercising.
He called me the moment he ___ the results.
___ she grew older, she became more patient.

options: I'll call you as soon as I will arrive.
I'll call you as soon as I arrive.
I'll call you as soon as I arriving.
items.why: Будущее после as soon as не ставится.

options: After having read the report, she called the director.
After have read the report, she called the director.
After to read the report, she called the director.
By the time you get there, we'll have finished.
By the time you will get there, we finish.
By the time you got there, we will finish.
Every time it will rain, the road floods.
Every time it rains, the road floods.
Every time it rained, the road floods.
items.why: Повторяющееся действие — **present simple** в обеих частях.

options: She has worked here since she graduated in 2019.
She has worked here since she has graduated in 2019.
She works here since she graduated in 2019.
items.why: **since** + past simple, а в главной — present perfect.

options: Once the data will be analysed, we'll publish it.
Once the data analysed, we'll publish it.
Once the data is analysed, we'll publish it.
We realised the problem until we checked again.
We didn't realise the problem until we checked again.
We didn't realise the problem since we checked again.

exercises.title: Соедините предложения
exercises.instruction: Соедините два предложения, используя союз в скобках. Время глаголов — естественное.

items.prompt: She finished the report. Then she went home. (after)
answers: After she finished the report, she went home.
After she had finished the report, she went home.
She went home after she finished the report.
She went home after she had finished the report.

items.prompt: I will see him. I'll give him your message. (when)
answers: I'll give him your message when I see him.
I will give him your message when I see him.
When I see him, I'll give him your message.
When I see him, I will give him your message.

items.prompt: The film started. We arrived. (by the time)
answers: By the time we arrived, the film had started.
The film had started by the time we arrived.

items.prompt: I haven't had a holiday. I started this job. (since)
answers: I haven't had a holiday since I started this job.
I have not had a holiday since I started this job.
Since I started this job, I haven't had a holiday.
Since I started this job, I have not had a holiday.

items.prompt: Don't open the box. The inspector will arrive. (until)
answers: Don't open the box until the inspector arrives.
Do not open the box until the inspector arrives.
Don't open the box until the inspector has arrived.
Do not open the box until the inspector has arrived.

items.prompt: She was driving. She heard the news. (while)
answers: She heard the news while she was driving.
While she was driving, she heard the news.

exercises.title: Переведите на английский
exercises.instruction: Переведите на английский, используя союзы времени.

items.prompt: Позвони мне, как только приедешь. (as soon as)
answers: Call me as soon as you arrive.
Call me as soon as you get there.
Call me as soon as you get here.
Phone me as soon as you arrive.
Give me a call as soon as you arrive.
While I was cooking, she was reading.
While I cooked, she read.
She was reading while I was cooking.
She read while I cooked.

items.prompt: Когда я приду, всё будет готово. (by the time)
answers: By the time I arrive, everything will be ready.
By the time I get there, everything will be ready.
By the time I come, everything will be ready.
By the time I get here, everything will be ready.

items.prompt: Я не знал об этом, пока ты не сказал. (until)
answers: I didn't know about it until you told me.
I didn't know about this until you told me.
I did not know about it until you told me.
I did not know about this until you told me.
I didn't know until you told me.
I did not know until you told me.

items.prompt: Каждый раз, когда идёт дождь, он берёт зонт.
answers: Every time it rains, he takes an umbrella.
Every time it rains he takes an umbrella.
Whenever it rains, he takes an umbrella.
Whenever it rains he takes an umbrella.
Every time it rains, he takes his umbrella.
Whenever it rains, he takes his umbrella.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя союзы времени.

items.prompt: What will you do as soon as you finish work or classes today?
items.sample: As soon as I finish work, I'll go to the gym.

items.prompt: What do you always do whenever you feel tired?
items.sample: Whenever I feel tired, I make a cup of strong tea and go for a short walk.

items.prompt: Describe something you were doing when something unexpected happened.
items.sample: I was crossing the street when I met an old friend.

items.prompt: How long have you been doing your job or studies? Use since + clause.
items.sample: I've lived in this city since I started university.
